#### When was the last earthquake in Henan, China?
A 4.5 magnitude earthquake hit near Henan on the morning of September 22, 2025 at 11:10 local time (Asia/Shanghai).
The center of this earthquake was located 149km southwest of Dengzhou at a depth of 10km under land.
Check the list on our website for any earthquakes occurring near Henan, China in the past hours.
#### What was the strongest earthquake near Henan, China?
A 7 magnitude earthquake hit near Henan on the night of August 1, 1937 at 04:35 local time (Asia/Shanghai).
The center of this earthquake was located 59km south-southeast of Puyang at a depth of 25km under land.
This is the strongest earthquake that occurred near Henan since the year 1900.
#### How often do earthquakes occur near Henan, China?
In the past 10 years, 25 earthquakes with a magnitude of four or higher occurred within a 300 kilometer range from Henan.
This averages to 3 earthquakes yearly, or one earthquake every 146 days.
